label: Colour Temperature
blurb: White balance in kelvin, done the way cameras and grading tools do it: say what colour the whites in the shot look like now (3200 K under tungsten bulbs, 5600 K in daylight, 7500 K in shade) and what they should look like, and every colour is adapted with the Bradford method, not just tinted. Light tint takes out a green or magenta cast from fluorescent or LED lights.
